subject: Clarify SOC2 Type II coverage: EOD inclusivity and point-in-time snapshots
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <security@finexcorp.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 period inclusivity + point-in-time snapshot question

Hi Dylan / Marissa,

We're preparing our security intake for the Finex payments integration and need a couple of clarifications on Redwood's SOC2 Type II report that will determine the evidence we ask for:

1) Report coverage: our reviewer reads the report period as 2025-06-01 through 2026-05-31. Can you confirm whether the last day (May 31, 2026) is inclusive for point-in-time coverage? In other words, do your logs and controls account for events up to 23:59:59 of that date, or is the period effectively up to the start of that day?

2) Timezone and timestamp granularity: Do your point-in-time snapshots / log exports use UTC timestamps? If a customer asks for an EOD export tied to their timezone (we operate in UTC), will the evidence reflect events to the second?

3) Bridge letter: if the auditor's formal report date doesn't cover a small window we need, would Redwood be able to provide a short bridge letter confirming coverage through a specified cutoff? If so, what wording has worked in the past and who signs?

If you can point me to a short sample log extract and a draft bridge letter, that would speed our approval. We need to close this by Friday (2026-06-19).

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Security Program Manager
Finex Corp
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <security@finexcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 period inclusivity + point-in-time snapshot question

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the clear questions. Short answers up front: we believe the auditor's Type II coverage is inclusive through 23:59:59 on the period end (UTC), and our exported logs include second-level timestamps, but I'll confirm with the audit team and the external auditor to make that official.

What I'll do next:
- Loop in our SOC2 lead (Marissa) and our Controls Engineer (Karthik) to pull a redacted sample log extract for May 31, 2026 EOD (UTC).
- Ask BrightRye (our auditor) whether they consider the last day inclusive for Type II evidence and whether they'd sign a brief bridge letter if needed.
- Attach a draft bridge letter we typically use so you can see proposed wording.

I've attached a short draft of a bridge letter (bridge-letter-draft.docx) — it's a two-paragraph signoff that either the auditor or our compliance lead can co-sign depending on their preference. Will aim to get formal confirmation by end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: bridge-letter-draft.docx (draft)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Bright <sam.bright@brightrye.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Quick confirm: EOD inclusivity for SOC2 Type II (Finex request)

Sam —

Finex (customer) has asked whether our SOC2 Type II report period (2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31) is inclusive of events through 23:59:59 on 2026-05-31, and whether our exported point-in-time logs use UTC with second-level granularity. They also asked whether BrightRye would sign a short bridge letter to cover any narrow gap if needed.

We have attached:
- SOC2_period_summary.pdf (high-level statement of coverage)
- sample-logs-202605.csv (redacted extract that shows EOD timestamps)
- draft bridge letter (attached previously by Dylan)

Can you confirm BrightRye's position on: 1) inclusivity to 23:59:59 UTC for the report period, and 2) willingness to issue a short bridge letter (auditor-signed) confirming coverage for a specified cutoff window? If you need additional wording for the bridge letter we can propose it.

Customer timeline: they'd like this confirmed by 2026-06-19 to complete their intake.

Thanks for the quick turn — appreciate it.

Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOC2_period_summary.pdf; sample-logs-202605.csv
From: Sam Bright <sam.bright@brightrye.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick confirm: EOD inclusivity for SOC2 Type II (Finex request)

Hi Marissa / team —

Thanks for the context and for the attachments. We reviewed the sample extract and the report scope. Our position:

1) Period inclusivity — BrightRye treats the report period end as inclusive up to 23:59:59 UTC on the stated last day (2026-05-31) for the purpose of Type II coverage. Where evidence exports are taken at 00:00 we still accept exports that capture events through 23:59:59 on the prior day, as long as the export metadata or log timestamps are provided to show that inclusion.

2) Timestamp granularity — the sample-logs-202605.csv shows second-level timestamps in UTC, which is acceptable for our review.

3) Bridge letter — we can issue a short auditor-signed bridge letter confirming coverage through a specific cutoff (e.g., "through 2026-05-31 23:59:59 UTC") provided: (a) the client (Redwood) confirms the exact cutoff wording, and (b) the client provides the final redacted evidence export for our file. We will prepare a one-paragraph letter (PDF) and can sign it.

Next steps we suggest:
- Redwood to confirm final cutoff wording (one-liner).
- Redwood to share the final redacted log export for May 31, 2026 (CSV) and a copy of the SOC2 report PDF.
- BrightRye to produce and sign the bridge-letter-signed.pdf and return via DocuSign if the client prefers.

If you'd like, I can draft the exact sentence we would sign and send it as a DocuSign envelope — that'll speed Finex's intake.

Best regards,
Sam Bright, CPA
Partner, BrightRye Audit LLP
Attachment: bridge-letter-signed.pdf (pending client confirmation)
